dimensions.assessment: Affects the general public receiving weather alerts, researchers, academic institutions, and emergency managers nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: system of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration by which the risks of hazardous weather and water events are communicated to the general public

dimensions.assessment: Aims to improve weather forecasting, risk communication, and public safety responses to severe weather events.
dimensions.evidence: goal of informing action and encouraging response to prevent loss of life and property

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $11,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2032 for the VORTEX-USA program.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Under Secretary to carry out this section $11,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2032

dimensions.assessment: Establishes new offices, research programs, strategic plans, and pilot programs within NOAA and amends the Weather Research and Forecasting Innovation Act of 2017.
dimensions.evidence: establish a hazard risk communication office... establish a research program... establish a pilot program

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes program funding and activities spanning fiscal years 2025 through 2032 alongside permanent statutory directives.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2032

missing_information: Cost estimates for provisions outside of the VORTEX-USA program authorizations are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs NOAA to alter its hazardous weather communication, research, and post-storm survey programs, and authorizes appropriations of $11 million annually for the VORTEX-USA program.
